links.outcome: AI-ECG HCM detection performance by sex and age subgroups
links.effect: Performed similarly in men and women; more sensitive in individuals <50 years but more specific in individuals ≥50 years.
links.quote: The AI-ECG algorithm performed similarly in both men and women, and was more sensitive in individuals <50 years but more specific in individuals ≥50 years.

links.outcome: False positive flags and sensitivity/PPV tradeoff across probability thresholds
links.effect: Of 1,265 flagged patients, 691 (54.6%) had alternate diagnosis; PPV highest (66%) at ≥0.95 but sensitivity 50%; ≥0.85 gave 95% sensitivity.
links.quote: The positive predictive value was the highest (66%) at the cutoff ≥0.95 but with a lower sensitivity at 50%.

links.outcome: Sensitivity and positive predictive value at alternative HCM probability thresholds
links.effect: At ≥0.95, positive predictive value was 66% and sensitivity 50%; at ≥0.85, sensitivity was 95%, with specificity and accuracy all >98%.
links.quote: The positive predictive value was the highest (66%) at the cutoff ≥0.95 but with a lower sensitivity at 50%.
